description:
Know where you stand on your rental hours. Pick the hour target you're aiming for, 100, 500 or 750, and LandlordHours shows your count, your pace to Dec 31, and the dated entries behind it. Short-term and long-term rentals, your hours and your spouse's, kept straight.

YOUR CALENDAR FINDS THE HOURS
• It looks back through your calendar for plumber visits, showings and inspections. You confirm what was rental work.
• Nothing counts until you say so.

LOG IT AND IT'S DATED
• Type what you did, like "fixed the sink at Oak St, 2 hours yesterday". The app fills in the property, category, hours and date.
• Run a timer while you work, or add time later.
• Attach photos, receipts and notes to any entry.

SEE WHERE YOU STAND
• Your count and pace for each hour target, on one screen.
• Each rental has its own count, short-term and long-term side by side.
• Your spouse's hours are logged separately from yours.

RECORDS YOUR CPA CAN USE
• Every entry is dated and tied to a property, a kind of work and a person.
• Export a clean PDF for your CPA.

YOUR WIDGET IS BACK
A redesigned Home Screen widget shows your house and your hours without opening the app.

STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE AND IN YOUR ICLOUD
• Apple's on-device model reads your calendar titles and notes on your iPhone.
• Your records are backed up through your own iCloud account.

LandlordHours keeps records. It is not tax, legal or financial advice, and it can't tell you whether you qualify for any tax status. Ask a licensed tax professional what your hours mean for you.
promotionalText: Aiming for 100, 500 or 750 hours? Your calendar finds the hours, you confirm them, and you see if you're on pace. Dated records your CPA can use.
